title: Add Three Numbers With One Adder
constraints: Your code may contain only **one** `+` (part-selects like `[i +: 8]` don't count), and no `-` or `*`.
hints: A full adder takes three bits and produces two (sum, carry). Apply it to all 8 bit positions in parallel: `s = a ^ b ^ c`, `cy = majority(a, b, c)`.
Now a + b + c = s + (cy << 1): three numbers reduced to two, without any carry propagation. That's a **carry-save adder**.
One final `+` adds the two. Multipliers use trees of these 3:2 compressors (Wallace trees).
